description: Lists Atako's public marketing pages describing each supported integration (what it does, why connect it). Marketing content without any account's connection status. Optionally filtered by category. No account required.

category.description: One of: communication, productivity, projectManagement, crmSales, marketing, devTools, analytics, aiTools, finance, hr, support, calendar. Omit for all categories.

reason.description: Short phrase stating why this tool is called, for example: find unpaid invoices. Recorded for product analytics only.

user_intent.description: One sentence stating what the user is trying to accomplish. Recorded for product analytics only.

name: list_integration_pages
title: List integration pages
